## Review gate

- [ ] This branch contains one reviewable milestone or a clearly scoped part of it.
- [ ] No `.env` values, privileged keys, passwords or session tokens are included.
- [ ] Relevant validation evidence is recorded in the implementation plan.
- [ ] Database changes include migration and test-data/cleanup instructions.
- [ ] User verification is complete before the milestone is marked complete.

Leave unchecked items unchecked until evidence is available. Do not merge or
start the next milestone until the current milestone passes the agreed gate.
